_comment: The week in the C Cubed. The scheduled job appends one object to weeks[] after each week finalizes: a lede, a write-up for each of the six games, and an 'around' notebook covering everything else that moved that week. articles[] holds longer pieces — draft reports, midseason takes — which are written by hand or on request rather than by the weekly job; the job must carry articles[] through untouched. The site sorts both newest-first and computes risers and sliders itself from its own power rankings, so nothing here should ever quote a rank or a movement.

weeks[].lede: one paragraph on the week as a whole - the shape of it, what mattered, what it set up

around[].kind: one of: trade, waivers, riser, slider, streak, injury, race, note
around[].headline: short, factual

articles[].headline: the piece's title
articles[].standfirst: optional short detail line next to the byline

blocks[].p: {type:'p', text, lead?}  - a paragraph; lead:true gets the drop cap. <b> is allowed, nothing else
blocks[].bars: {type:'bars', title, sub, rows:[{label, sub, value, group}]}  - diverging bars about zero; group 1-3 picks the colour
blocks[].cards: {type:'cards', items:[{title, big, sub, lead?, rows:[{label, value}]}]}
